answer.title: Automate Rescheduling from Helpdesk Tickets
answer.trigger: A customer submits a helpdesk ticket requesting to reschedule a booking.
steps: Read the incoming helpdesk ticket to identify the customer and requested new time.
Search the jobs system for the customer's existing booking.
Draft the booking reschedule in the jobs system.
Send a confirmation reply to the customer in the helpdesk.
answer.ai_help: Extracts the customer details and requested date from the ticket message.
answer.human_approval: Claire must approve the new booking time in the jobs system before the change is finalized.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation picks the wrong time or customer, a booking could be scheduled incorrectly, causing missed appointments and unhappy customers.
